body:
Preserves and continues the existing PR #80 ETL workflow-first foundation, migration 0039, job/dependency APIs, monitoring projection and filter fix. Adds the OC-ARCH-001 architecture baseline and repairs the OC-ETL-002 request-scope integration blocker.

## Scope repair

The new ETLWorkflow and ETLWorkflowDependency models were absent from the shared scope registry. Route-level permission mocks passed, but the actual request before_flush hook rejected writes even for administrators. Register both models through existing ownership traversal; enforce immutable parent/customer/endpoint IDs, same-workflow/customer/environment references and complete child-resource visibility. Existing deny-by-default hooks, RBAC and transactional audit remain enabled. No migration rewrite or security allowlist bypass.

## Verification

Exact tested product commit: a590f426ff6ed679968688ea9486c70456cf6cc2.
- 77 real PostgreSQL regressions PASS, zero failures/skips: 19 new scope tests, 16 foundation, 22 existing RBAC and 20 existing incident tests.
- 21 authenticated HTTP assertions within those tests: authorized workflow/job/dependency writes and existing updates, viewer reads, unauthorized/cross-tenant/invalid relationship rejection and inactive workflow safeguards.
- Fresh migrations through 0039 and alembic check PASS.
- Workflow syntax validation, compile and final focused lint PASS. Dedicated disposable scope harness is now included in pipeline-v16 CI with artifact retention; hosted final-head CI remains separately assessed.
- Earlier fixture uniqueness/expectation failures are retained. Four runs removed their owned containers and stopped APIs. No production/UAT access or broad Docker cleanup.

Report, raw logs, commands, failures, source hashes and manifests: docs/verification/oc-etl-002/REPORT.md.

## Architecture baseline

Six requested documents under docs/architecture/unified-implementation-baseline trace all 33 journey slots (31 included, Journey 20 excluded, Journey 32 skipped), 16 ETL requirements, eight licensing design statements and the inherited approved Pentaho contract. Thirty exact numbered journey definitions remain unrecovered; no inferred journey mappings or fabricated approvals. Existing PR80 milestones remain preserved. Missing source decisions are distinct from implementation defects.

Commits: 092ed0711f4fbc60a90fe814518df8e3a0707bc9 (baseline); a590f426ff6ed679968688ea9486c70456cf6cc2 (scope repair); a9fe107816fb91583b4262746a5c0a2c244c0e15 (evidence/CI wiring).

## Remaining boundaries

CF-01 repaired for scoped persistence. Populated migration rollback (CF-02) and concurrent DAG-cycle acceptance (CF-03) remain open; neither is implied by fresh migration or sequential-cycle tests. Resource-limited creation of empty/unbound workflows remains fail-closed; no authority expansion. Legacy reassignment and dependency endpoint mutation remain prohibited. Genuine providers, event-policy detail, licensing and retired-channel authority remain unresolved.

Monitoring-only: no ETL execution, scheduling or retry controls; no Service Catalog/Kubernetes reintroduction. No merge, deployment, collector upgrade, branch-protection change or waiver. Keep draft.

CHK-001 FAIL · CHK-002 BLOCKED · SECURITY BLOCKED · RELEASE NO-GO.


## OC-ETL-003: rollback safety and concurrent DAG integrity

Populated Workflow rollback previously dropped foundation data, and graph validation had no per-workflow transaction lock. The guarded migration runner now refuses unsafe populated downgrade before DDL without changing applied revisions. Dependency creation uses an authorized workflow row lock and a complete graph read. Only this route uses a shared authorization advisory lock; revocation/access mutations retain the exclusive lock and unchanged principal/session validation.

Implementation tested at `f57153836615fb07d748ede6b49af6a11dba96fe`; evidence commits `2b2bff1` and final HEAD `a420dbc12e66196e00832f450d46a739b7cd0e99`.

Validation: 84 PostgreSQL-backed regression tests PASS, 0 failures/errors/skips; six preservation groups PASS, including fresh/populated upgrade, safe empty/unassigned downgrade, refused populated rollback with unchanged table hashes, native identity/evidence guards, and actual pg_dump/pg_restore equivalence. Seven new authenticated HTTP concurrency cases include cycle/duplicate rejection, nonconflicting writes, independent workflows, timeout rollback and authorization-lock exclusion. All failed attempts and scoped cleanup retained. Applied migration hashes unchanged. Hosted final-head CI is pending, not claimed PASS.

Evidence: [report](docs/verification/oc-etl-003/REPORT.md), [rollback contract](docs/verification/oc-etl-003/ROLLBACK_COMPATIBILITY.md), [concurrency tests](docs/verification/oc-etl-003/CONCURRENCY.md), [artifact checksums](docs/verification/oc-etl-003/ARTIFACT_SHA256.json). Unified architecture traceability updated without inventing journey authority.

Limits: no guarantee for privileged SQL bypass, unsupported transaction isolation, every old populated downgrade chain, older runner checkouts, customer recovery or provider certification. Review remains required. CHK-001 FAIL · CHK-002 BLOCKED · SECURITY BLOCKED · RELEASE NO-GO. Keep draft; no merge or deployment.


## OC-ETL-003A.1 — CI compatibility and approved roadmap scope

Final source/evidence HEAD: `ed4c011dddd8de7a5f5d8c816d391608c1597f5f`. Implementation: `64098b0`; execution-log retention: `3a9726b`.

Corrects all four identified migration CI regressions: central populated-refusal contract checks now retain data/schema/revision comparisons and recovery guidance; staging uses the explicit 0023 predecessor; NOC preserves populated incident history while retaining empty rollback and repeat-upgrade checks; restored Pentaho refusal recognizes the central guard. Production guard, RBAC, DAG locks and historical migrations are byte-identical to baseline.

Local verification: 84/84 owned PostgreSQL/HTTP regressions; six migration/backup/restore groups; 18/18 focused tests; V1.5 PostgreSQL suite 595 cases (569 pass, 26 explicit owned-scope skips covered by the separate 84-test run), full HTTP/browser suite PASS; full local staging and synthetic NOC/theme/recovery browser runs PASS. Exact logs, failure attempts, versions, hashes and cleanup are under `docs/verification/oc-etl-003a/REPORT.md`.

CI roadmap matrix covers 56 recovered requirement/design IDs and all 33 journey slots: 31 included, Journey20 excluded, Journey32 skipped, 30 exact definitions SOURCE_NOT_RECOVERED. Nine owner decisions supplied in the conversation use OWNER_APPROVED_CONTROLLED_SCOPE — INDEPENDENT_UAT_PENDING. No independent UAT/provider certification is inferred. Existing backend-validation now validates this traceability; actionlint covers modified workflows.

Hosted final-HEAD CI: all 18 checks completed SUCCESS, including all four previously failing workflows. Exact conclusions and machine-readable check evidence: https://github.com/Parikshit-Sahrawat/OpsControl_Dashboard/pull/80#issuecomment-6680327152. OC-ETL-004 UI work is a separate subsequent task. Keep draft. No merge/deploy. CHK-001 FAIL · CHK-002 BLOCKED · SECURITY BLOCKED · RELEASE NO-GO.


## OC-ETL-004 — Workflow/Job configuration and bounded readiness

Implementation `1d3004d24c67279746b6225e8951c9bf2b534075`; read-only expectations and exact clean tested source `6a9c7a2cc2eafbac76b6e7b48a54d35c9d115f19`; final evidence HEAD `9c021bbb94de3017bdc9f41b6a774d7b378ae9a7`.

Resource Management now provides Workflow list/create/edit/details, supported calendar/windows/duration/SLA, child Job name/host/runtime configuration, directed dependencies, and read-only expectations/receipts for viewer roles. Organization/environment selection, save/reload, invalid/failed-save preservation and stale tenant-response guards are covered. The existing secured mutation handlers, DAG locks, scope/audit hooks, protected migrations, collector pin and OC-ETL-003A CI corrections are unchanged.

Controlled verification: 85/85 real PostgreSQL/API regression tests (84 retained + one Chromium integration case), 19 actual authenticated browser groups, independent database reconciliation, six migration/backup/restore groups, 21 retained HTTP status assertions, and 45/45 frontend tests. Lint/build/static/workflow checks pass; task container/API/UI cleanup confirmed. Earlier failed attempts remain preserved. All 18 final-HEAD hosted checks completed SUCCESS. Exact conclusions and bounded-scope delivery evidence: https://github.com/Parikshit-Sahrawat/OpsControl_Dashboard/pull/80#issuecomment-6681949516. Contract-dependent gaps remain BLOCKED; new ETL owner acceptance remains pending.

**Explicit incomplete contracts:** frequency/recurrence/calendar details, a separate Job long-running threshold, native PipelineJob→Workflow Job binding, authoritative Workflow activation and full operational readiness remain BLOCKED. Backend readiness only describes supported child runtime fields; activation is BLOCKED and provider connectivity UNVERIFIED. A saved configuration never claims healthy/active monitoring. No workload Run/Retry/Stop/Terminate actions exist.

Evidence: `docs/verification/oc-etl-004/2026-11-06/REPORT.md`, `OPEN_GAPS.md`, raw logs, screenshots, source hashes and artifact manifest. ETL-02/03/15/16 traceability updated; 31 journeys and 30 unrecovered numbered definitions retained; Journey20 excluded, Journey32 skipped. Nine prior approvals remain OWNER_APPROVED_CONTROLLED_SCOPE — INDEPENDENT_UAT_PENDING; new ETL functionality is pending owner acceptance.

Keep draft. No merge/deployment or release waiver. CHK-001 FAIL · CHK-002 BLOCKED · SECURITY BLOCKED · RELEASE NO-GO.

Test-only implementation: `3852c8d81f6fad4628c30f3cd0f8adaea6dc52f7`; final contracts/evidence HEAD: `a915322b5c5c80b0d37dea71f6b7f70237082340`. No production handlers, models, migrations, permissions or collector configuration changed.

Existing staged FK chain is verified: PipelineJob.resource_id → MonitoringResource.job_order_id → JobOrder.workflow_id. Registration remains quarantined/unselected. The proposed temporal binding and six-dimensional readiness contracts require accountable D01–D10 decisions; no new Workflow activation or provider certification is claimed. Current association DELETE removes the link row; preserved receipts do not establish complete historical binding provenance.

Controlled PostgreSQL 17.11 verification: 86 tests PASS, 0 failures/errors/skips; includes 36 new authenticated HTTP status assertions, retained 19 browser groups and six migration/backup/restore groups. OC-ETL-004 — supported Workflow/Job configuration delivery; contract-dependent scope remains explicitly BLOCKED.

Final PR HEAD `9c021bbb94de3017bdc9f41b6a774d7b378ae9a7`. Implementation `1d3004d24c67279746b6225e8951c9bf2b534075`; read-only expectation details and exact locally tested source `6a9c7a2cc2eafbac76b6e7b48a54d35c9d115f19`. All **18 final-head hosted checks completed SUCCESS**, including the pipeline's new authenticated PostgreSQL/Chromium acceptance.

Implemented inside Resource Management: Workflow list/create/edit/details; customer/environment selection; supported timezone/weekdays/windows/Workflow duration/SLA; child Job name/host/runtime create/edit; immutable ownership; directed dependencies with actual backend cycle/tenant protection; read-only persisted expectations and execution receipts for viewer roles; backend freshness, loading/error/empty states, reload persistence, unsaved-edit preservation and tenant-response guards.

Minimal backend change: existing monitoring GET adds read-only hostname/freshness and explicitly bounded supported-child-runtime configuration status. Mutation handlers, authorization/audit hooks, DAG locks, migration protection/applied revisions, production collector pin and prior CI corrections remain unchanged. No external ETL execution, scheduling, retry or termination controls.

Actual controlled verification:
- 85 PostgreSQL/API regression tests PASS, zero failures/errors/skips (84 retained plus one browser integration case).
- 19 real authenticated browser groups PASS, zero page runtime errors; controlled network failure and delayed **real** response used only for failure/stale-response tests.
- 45 frontend tests PASS, zero failures/skips; lint/build/static/workflow checks PASS.
- Six migration preservation/backup/restore groups PASS; 21 retained HTTP status assertions PASS.
- Independent PostgreSQL reconciliation proves windows 08:00–10:00, SLA900, Workflow duration500, child runtimes150/120, parent/customer/environment/host identity, one dependency and unchanged legacy/foreign associations.
- Exact task container removed and API/UI stopped; no broad Docker cleanup, production or owner UAT access. Browser lab uses PostgreSQL Docker and owned loopback API/Vite processes; it does not claim an API/frontend-container browser topology.

**Still BLOCKED:** recurrence/frequency/calendar detail contract, separate Job long-running threshold, native PipelineJob→Workflow Job binding, authoritative Workflow activation and full operational readiness. The UI displays these gaps. Supported configuration status is not overall Workflow health; activation is BLOCKED and provider connectivity UNVERIFIED. Existing source names/hostnames are never invented as native identity. New ETL owner acceptance and genuine-provider/independent UAT remain pending.
